profile_text.body:
Coursera is an online learning platform founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. It is a for-profit public company trading under the ticker COUR. According to its website, Coursera offers online courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees from organizations including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford. The company describes its offerings as job-ready skills and verifiable credentials from respected universities and companies.

The site highlights programs in project management, UX design, data science, cybersecurity, and AI. It names specific certificates such as the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, Google UX Design Professional Certificate, IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, and AI Engineer Professional Certificate. Coursera Plus is an annual subscription that gives learners unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates. The company's site also points to AI-related offerings including the AI Essentials Specialization, Machine Learning Specialization, Deep Learning Specialization, and beginner-friendly generative AI courses.

Court records associated with Coursera are concentrated in California, with 281 entries. No specific lawsuits are listed. The company files with the SEC under CIK 0001651562.
